name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods: plugins of function hooks that change what Claude Code itself shows and does

plugins.name: merge-status
plugins.description: Shows the open merge requests (GitLab) or pull requests (GitHub) of the current branch under the prompt, with pipeline and conflict signs

plugins.name: skill-usage
plugins.description: Counts how often each skill is invoked, by you and by Claude, against sessions, prompts and turns, and shows it above the prompt with /skill-usage
